hook.name: ReflexHook
hook.description: ReflexHook implements a custom bonding-curve AMM (RFLX/ETH) with band-based liquidity on Uniswap v4. It collects ETH fees on swaps via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapReturnDelta, stakes collected ETH through Lido (stETH), and redeploys yield as add-only floor liquidity. Trading is gated by an owner-activated `started` boolean flag.
